facts.value: Connects the DownSpot prone animation used by grounded defeated fighters to the shared orientation-matched DownWait state. DownWait initializes its wait timer, but does not decrement it while the persistent defeated flag x2224_b2 is set; this is not necessarily ordinary timed floor recovery.
facts.rationale: Preserves the proven orientation transition while correcting the omission of the defeated-state timer lifetime.

evidence.why: Animation completion delegates to DownWait initialization.
Orientation mapping, timer initialization and defeated-flag suppression.
Defeat sets the flag and dispatches grounded fighters to DownSpot.
